source: Laxmikanth Indian Polity 8th ed. Appendix lists of PMs / Deputy PMs (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-03.txt) p.203-205; pmindia.gov.in (Former Prime Ministers)

from_notes: President | 60 | CJI | Vice-President
x: Art. 56(1)(a): the President may resign by writing under his hand addressed to the Vice-President - not the CJI, PM or CEC.
source: PMF Polity Notes Part 2 (src/polity/pmf-polity-02.txt) p.1-2

x: The Governor holds office during the President's pleasure (Art. 156) and has no impeachment procedure; the President is impeached (Art. 61), and the CJI and VP have removal procedures.
source: Laxmikanth Indian Polity 8th ed. (src/polity/laxmikanth-indian-polity-01.txt) p.282; PMF Polity Notes Part 2 (src/polity/pmf-polity-02.txt) p.8
dispute: Most books and keys: the Governor. Strictly: the Constitution uses 'impeachment' only for the President (Art. 61); the VP (Art. 67(b)) and the CJI (Art. 124(4)) are 'removed', not impeached.

from_notes: - Oaths of President, VP and Governor are in **Articles 60, 69, 159** – **not** the Third Schedule; Ministers' oaths are in the Third Schedule.
x: The Third Schedule holds the oaths of Union Ministers, Supreme Court judges (incl. the CJI) and MPs; the President's oath is in Art. 60, not the Third Schedule - so 1, 2, 4.
source: PMF Polity Notes Part 2 (src/polity/pmf-polity-02.txt) p.1-2; Constitution Third Schedule

from_notes: PM, Union Ministers | 75(4), Third Schedule | President | President

from_notes: - Oaths of President, VP and Governor are in **Articles 60, 69, 159** – **not** the Third Schedule; Ministers' oaths are in the Third Schedule.

from_notes: 77(3) | The President makes rules for the convenient transaction of business and its allocation among Ministers – Allocation of Business Rules and Transaction of Business Rules, 1961
x: Statement 1 is wrong: Ministries/Departments are created by the President on the PM's advice under the Allocation of Business Rules (Art. 77(3)), not by the PM with the Cabinet Secretary. Statement 2 is right: the President allocates portfolios on the PM's advice. Only 2.
